rules: Repository release target, release-target status, controlling published baseline, artifact lifecycle, publication maturity, specification version, and baseline date are separate metadata dimensions.
Active controlled artifacts in the v2.0.1 worktree use lifecycle CURRENT and publication status CURRENT unless a more specific controlled lifecycle applies.
The v2.0.1 worktree remains unreleased until a release decision is recorded; this does not change the controlling published v2.0.0 Public Review Controlled Baseline.
Working Draft is reserved for artifacts intentionally outside the controlled current repository set.
Implementation Profiles retain their own controlled lifecycle and status values.
